categories.main_business_segments: Guangzhou Tinci Materials Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in fine chemical new materials, focusing on lithium-ion battery materials and daily chemical materials & specialty chemicals. The lithium-ion battery segment includes electrolytes and cathode materials like lithium iron phosphate, while the daily chemical segment produces surfactants, silicone oils, polymers, and specialty chemicals for personal care and industrial applications.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced chemical synthesis and process engineering technologies, including proprietary methods for producing lithium hexafluorophosphate, lithium salts like LiFSI, and solid-state electrolytes. It has mature production technologies for electrolytes and cathode materials, with ongoing R&D in sodium-ion batteries, solid-state batteries, and polymer binders. Continuous process optimization and patent-protected innovations underpin its manufacturing.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include manufacturers in the new energy vehicle sector, consumer electronics, and energy storage industries for lithium-ion battery materials. The daily chemical products serve personal care brands, household cleaning, and various industrial sectors such as paper, agriculture, and oilfield chemicals. The company also targets international markets, especially in North America, Europe, and Southeast Asia.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are primarily based in China with multiple production bases across Guangzhou, Jiangxi, Zhejiang, Sichuan, and other provinces. The company has established overseas subsidiaries and production facilities in the United States, Germany, Singapore, Czech Republic, Morocco, South Korea, and Zimbabwe, reflecting a growing international footprint.
categories.supply_chain_position: Tinci operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, producing key raw materials and components for lithium-ion batteries and specialty chemicals. It integrates upstream raw material production, including lithium salt refining and recycling, and extends downstream into battery material recycling and polymer binders, forming a vertically integrated supply chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation in high-performance, cost-effective lithium battery materials, including fast-charging electrolytes, high-density cathode materials, and solid-state electrolytes. It invests in resource recycling and sustainable production, expands global market presence, and develops new materials for emerging applications like sodium-ion batteries and automotive electronics adhesives. R&D is supported by a large, highly educated team and extensive patent portfolio.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of chemical products and materials, including lithium-ion battery electrolytes, cathode materials, and daily chemical products. The company also earns income from licensing, government subsidies, and financial instruments related to commodity hedging. Sales are predominantly on a product basis with technical service and solution support.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Tinci is positioned as a leading domestic player in lithium-ion battery materials and fine chemicals, competing with other major Chinese and international chemical and battery material manufacturers. It holds a strong market position due to its integrated supply chain, technological innovation, and expanding global footprint, particularly in lithium battery electrolytes and lithium iron phosphate cathode materials.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 12.5 billion, a decrease of 18.74% year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 484 million, down 74.40%. Despite short-term declines due to market competition and raw material price fluctuations, the company maintains significant scale with ongoing capacity expansions and international investments, signaling a focus on long-term growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Tinci emphasizes high-quality, cost-effective, and innovative chemical materials with strong R&D capabilities and proprietary technologies. Its vertically integrated supply chain and resource recycling capabilities provide cost advantages and sustainability. The company offers customized solutions, stable supply, and global service networks, differentiating itself through technological leadership, product quality, and comprehensive lifecycle support for lithium battery materials.
